segmentation.text: A signal of intention to turn right or left, or otherwise turn a vehicle from a direct course, shall be given continuously during not less than the last 100 feet traveled
in a business or residential district
and not less than the last 300 feet traveled
This rule shall be observed, regardless of the weather.

elements.justification: A signal of intention to turn is the signal itself, not a declared intention (the ontology: "a signal 'of intention' is the signal"): sig.turn_indicator ("the turn indicator state ∈ {off, left, right}") or sig.hand_signal ("a driver's or rider's arm signal; meaning ∈ {no_signal, left, right, stop_or_slow, re_enter}") showing the side of the change of course; sig.turn_indicator is 'not a stand-in' for the turn itself, which is read separately. A direct course is travel along the designated direction of the carrier x occupies (rel.occupies a st.travel_region carrying st.lane_direction); turning right or left or otherwise from it is x's velocity departing to one side of that direction, the proposed concepts drv.motion.veering_left and drv.motion.veering_right ("it moves forward along the carrier while its velocity points to the left [right] of the carrier's direction by more than a tolerance", from kin.velocity and kin.speed); following a bend of the carrier is not a departure, since the designated direction bends with it. 'given continuously during not less than the last 100 feet traveled' is a window measured in distance travelled (a .path window, which reads kin.path_length: "distance travelled along the body's path since the start of the trace, monotone") at every observation of which the signal of the departure's side is shown; the figure is the law's literal.
The same .path window (kin.path_length) with the law's other literal, the bound selected where the place is not in a business or residence district (span f7).

Changing the course is the observation at which a departure to one side begins: drv.motion.veering_left or drv.motion.veering_right holds for a carrier x occupies (rel.occupies) and held for none at the observation before. The signal window ends there.

'vehicle' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle ("every device in, upon or by which any person or property is or may be transported or drawn upon a highway"), claimed by id: the subject x whose course changes.

assumptions.meaning: The place of the observation lies inside a business district or a residence district declared for the map or the trace.
The place of the observation lies inside a business district or a residence district declared for the map or the trace.

residues.why: The duty is the same in every weather: the words exclude no weather and add no condition, so no environment atom is read.

applicability: x carries ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle and at the observation begins a change of course: for some travel region c that x occupies (rel.occupies), drv.motion.veering_left(x, c) or drv.motion.veering_right(x, c) (with p.speed_resolution and p.course_departure_sine) holds there, and at the observation before neither held for any region x occupied.
obligation: For a departure to the left, x showed a left signal (sig.turn_indicator left, or sig.hand_signal left) at every observation of the window behind the observation measured in x's distance travelled (.path, kin.path_length), whose length is the literal of span f1 where asm.within_business_or_residence_district holds at the observation and the literal of span f6 where it does not (a bound selected by the condition); for a departure to the right, the right signal likewise. A departure to both sides at once owes the signal of either.

narrowings.why: 'otherwise turn a vehicle from a direct course' is read as the velocity departing to one side of the designated direction of the carrier the vehicle occupies, on lanes, roadways and other carriers that carry a direction; a turn begun where the vehicle occupies only an intersection, which carries no direction, is not recognized.

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: x (ru.motor_vehicle) on a rural road (asm.within_business_or_residence_district declared false) begins a lane change to the left; its sig.turn_indicator showed left only over a path shorter than the literal of span f6 before the departure began, off before that.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: Same rural lane change; sig.turn_indicator showed left at every observation of a path longer than the literal of span f6 before the departure.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: x drives along its lane following its designated direction, never departing to either side.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: x begins a lane change to the left, but the source observes neither its turn indicator nor any arm signal.

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: In a declared business district x begins a departure to the right with sig.turn_indicator right shown over a path longer than the literal of span f1 but shorter than that of span f6.

scenarios.name: branch_2
scenarios.narrative: x begins a departure to the right with sig.turn_indicator left shown over the whole window: the signal is not of the side of the change.

param_proposals.name: p.speed_resolution
param_proposals.convention: Sensor resolution: the smallest speed the acquisition standard separates from standstill; a speed at or below it counts as no motion.
param_proposals.source: speed resolution of the carla_scene_graph acquisition standard

param_proposals.name: p.course_departure_sine
param_proposals.convention: Course-departure tolerance: the sine of the angle between a road user's velocity and its carrier's designated direction beyond which it counts as leaving its direct course rather than tracking the carrier; about three degrees, above heading noise and lane-keeping drift.
param_proposals.source: lane-change onset detection practice in naturalistic driving studies
